title: EFC — Unresolved Questions and Challenges: Entropy
abstract: This position paper outlines unresolved questions about how entropy interacts with energy flow in Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) and how this interplay might sustain localized order and the stability of space-time’s present moment. It proposes observational and modeling avenues—such as gravitational-wave analyses, CMB entropy proxies, edge-of-universe (halo) observations, and spectral-shift studies—to probe entropy–energy dynamics near cosmic extremes.
